name: Chintu
species: thin, clever village boy (about 8 years old)
personality: quick-thinking, curious inventor, a little nervous. FUNNY: shouts 'IDEA!' and jumps, but his first idea is always hilariously wrong; his glasses slide off his nose; talks super fast when excited; catchphrase 'Don't worry, I have a plan... a slightly wobbly plan!'
look: thin boy, warm brown skin, spiky black hair, big round black glasses, large ears, green-and-white striped T-shirt, brown shorts, red sneakers
